Well, now I'm doing another business other than\nsmithing. And I find it difficult to make money\nby selling cheap stuffs.
When I was a blacksmith, I didn't care about\nprofitability for good swords but...\nIf I did that now, I would lose money in a second.
When I was in another town, an owner of a general\nstore called Lilulu was always calculating\nsomething like costs and selling prices...
I and the synthesist girl asked her if she had\nto calculate everything...\nBut now I think I should have asked her about it...
Welcome. What do you need today?\nI have various items here.\nNo need to hurry. Enjoy shopping.
Thanks! Come again.\nI sometimes stock some items that I find\nirregularly, so visit me often. Take care.
Litoa's General Store
Litoa's Storage
Failed to receive the reward. The bag is full.\nPlease check the bag and report again.
Have you been traveling long?...Oh, quite long.\nUs? We've been moving around to look for a nice\nplace for a new country, so not sure how long.
After Kunon’s announcement, the Diels gradually\ngathered in the land we once chose as the capital.\nIt became too packed and we had to move again...
Nov Saterica, which we took long to find, has a\nvast land enough for other Diels to come and there\nare few conflicts with other countries. So nice.
Well, my only complaint is the weather. It keeps\nchanging only after a few minutes of walk because\nof the Catastrophe.
Diel's Town\n[ffff64]Nov Saterica[ffffff]
Whoaaa... What a big town it is...
Looks like it was built recently...\nHeh heh! Could be a great chance to capture new\ncustomers...
Trrrreasurreee!!
Wa! Waaaa! What is this?!\nI think this has happened to me before...
Well, well. Such people really do exist.\nPeople who get caught in such obvious traps!
Well, well. Such people really do exist.\nPeople who get caught in such obvious traps!\n...You again?!
Agghhh! It's you again!!\n...That was my line, you know.\nRelease me now!
You never learn, girl.\nMeh... Here!
Geh!
... Owwww... Don't you you know if you release\nsomeone while they're upside down they'll\nfall on their head!?
Sorrrrry!
Sorrrrry!\nBut wow, you guys came all this way!\nIt must have been...
...I mean, you must be pretty skilled to come so\nfar while putting up with such a bothersome girl!
Heeey!! Who're you callin' bothersome!?\nLately I've started fighting too, you know!!\nAnyway, what have you been doing with yourself?
Me?
After joining up with the migration caravan\nin Maia Diela, I was protecting them\nas we traveled here.
Then, after we set up town, I took on\nthe role of protecting the town from monsters\nand bandits.
I'm keeping watching over several traps here,\nlike the one that caught you before.\nI'm not having much luck with advanced traps...
But to think there are people like you\nwho get caught in the simple ones...
We...Well!\nI must curse my habit to jump on things that look\nlike treasures...
But anyways, what are you guys doing in\nNov Saterica?\nCome on in.
The biggest building up ahead is the president's\noffice, where our leader, the Goddess of Justice is.\nSo, go introduce yourself but don't be rude, OK?
It seems this is the only shop open.
I think... It's just a general store, but\nthere's a hammer, so maybe a blacksmith...\nI wonder if the shopkeeper is in...
Y'all lookin' to buy?
Waaah!\nW-What are you!?
What I am is this shop's owner, but...\nHm? Y'all don't look familiar...
Well, we just got here now,\nso of course we're not familiar.
But anyway, what kind of shop is it?\nA general store? Kind of looks like a\nblacksmith too, though...
Ah, now it's a general store.\nOriginally it was a blacksmith, but it was\ncramped and I didn't have enough tools...
Gosh, I really miss the old Rugio Town.\nIt was burned down by a dragon, you know...
I heard that Rugio Town was destroyed in an\ninstant, but I didn't know a dragon did it...
Yea, a horrible dragon.\nIn a flash, the whole town was like a sea of fire...\nIt's a miracle I was safe...
Well, I still plan to do blacksmithing.\nThat hammer and anvil over there, and that\nequipment are all waiting for that time...
But that's another story for another day. Anyway.\nI can't make just anything, of course,\nbut come to me if you need something...
I'll be around here.
Huhhh... So this is the president's office.\nSo the president of the Diel country should\nbe in here. I wonder what he's like....
Hey, we're here to see the goddess...
How unusual to see a visitor.\nIn you go, then.
Eh? Huh? You mean we can just waltz right in?\nAt least check our IDs, or why we're here...
Nah, we don't bother with that!\nThe Goddess of Justice, Kunon, said that anyone\nwho wants to see her should come on in.
Well, there are some really skilled soldiers\ninside, so whatever happens, he'll be fine.\nSo... What then? You want in or out?
In! In! I need to meet him and get a spot for\nmy new business...
In! In! I need to meet him and get a spot for\nmy new business... Uh, but anyway, let us in.
What are you doin'?! Let's go.
[ffff64]Nov Saterica[ffffff]\nThe Office of the President
Hm? I haven't seen you around here…\nYou seem like a... Straye?\n…Aha, I was right! Hahahaha!!
U-Umm, and you're here because…
Me? I'm head of the Diel's new country, the New\nMithurna Federation, and the new Goddess of\nJustice, Kunon Obligaus Garan. Nice to see you...
Hey, is she really the Goddess of Justice?\nShe speaks roughly compared to Pino.
Kunon speaks like Curonne that you met in the\nforest. Sounds like she is really her daughter...
Ha ha ha! No wonder you doubt it.\nI'm still often scolded for lack of awareness\nas the elder and goddess...
Now I'll answer your questions.\nMaybe you will believe that I'm a goddess if I tell\nyou about the country and city, right?
What's the Diel's new country?
What did you do until the town was built?
Why did they build Nov Saterica here?
Nothing.
Once, there was a huge federation called Mithurna,\nwhich consisted of Diel's city states.
My momm...
My momm... My mother was the president.\nBut people and our lands were torn apart by the\nCataclysm...
So, I called Diels in different areas and came\nall the way to here. Then, we built the New\nMithurna Federation.
We traveled all over the world to find other Diels\nand persuaded them to build a new country...
Everyone was doubtful at first but as more Diels\njoined us, we formed a big migration caravan.
And we reached here.
Since New Mithurna Federation is literally new,\nwe didn't have enough arms and facilities to\nprotect the capital town.
So we had to find a place where we won't make wars\nagainst other countries.
We kept traveling to find the place and finally\nwe found it and built the federation here.
How did you like it?\nDo you believe now?
Well, yea. You had a hard time building the country.\nSo, is everything going alright?
Hmm... The downtown of Nov Saterica is safe...\nBut the weather and land form around the town are\nnot stable and complicated.
And there are unknown ruins underground so\nit takes too long to develop the land...
...I asked Arrol, an archaeologist whom we met\nwhile we were traveling, to investigate the\nunderground but...
I haven't heard from him for a while.\nI'm worried about him...
...Where is the last place he was seen, you ask?\nHe was in the forest next to the town but a report\nsays that some part of the forest is like a maze.
And some soldiers we sent to there haven't come\nback yet...
As the president of the New Mithurna Federation,\nI would like to officially request you...\nFind the lost archaeologist!
We have to hurry to the Eldenbaum, you know...
Oh, right.\nHe could be caught by Coenubia.\nAlright. Let's go find him.
Arrol reported to Kunon that he found an inscription\nabout the gods in deep of Curonne Forest...
What? An inscription about the gods?!
Hmm...\nThe place must be the library of a researcher...
W-Whaaat?!\nIsn't it a part of the ruins of the gods?
If that was it, it could be partly broken after\nthe Cataclysm but couldn't be covered in moss...
And I've heard that the temple that the 12 gods\nwere living used to be more magnificent.
Oh, no...
But the inscription you found must be written\nabout the 12 gods...
We might get clues about the gods' temple from it!
You guys, can you help him find the entrance of\nthe gods' temple?
Wait, wait, wait!
We're also interested in the temple but we have\na mission to pass through the elf mountains and\ninvestigate Eldenbaum.
We can't quit in the middle...
...Could I go to Mt. Mithurna first with them?
NO!\nI said you can't go there, didn't I?
But the inscription said there are clues in\nMt. Mithurna!
How can I do nothing knowing that?!
It's true there are various god's properties in\nthe mountain. However! That's because my father\nObligaus the former God of Justice lives in there!!
Whaaat?!
Really?!
It's not official, so I didn't wanna say it...
Obligaus... He's old an stubborn.\nI'm sure you will be involved in trouble if you\nsee him... I warn you!
Then, now it's obvious that the clues are in\nMt. Mithurna! There's no option but to go!!
Please!\nAllow me to go investigate there!!
Mmm...\nYou're as stubborn as he is...
Did you hear that?\nMt. Mithurna is on the way to elf mountains.\nCan you help him out?
Well, the direction is the same so...\nBut I don't wanna get involved with your dad's\ntrouble.
I understand...
Then, before going Mt. Mithurna, go to [ffff64]Rokoko Plains[ffffff]\nand get [ffff64]5 Rokoko Grapes[ffffff] and put them in the casks\nat the Forgotten Cave.
Next, pour spring water in the cave and seal it...
And?
You get wine. Take it and go to Mt. Mithurna.\nIf my father is in a bad mood, hand it over to him.\nHis mood will get better immediately...
He's a god, isn't he?\nIs a god that simple??
Not all gods...\nBut my father is simply... simple.
I'm counting on you guys.
Wind Ark?
Yeah, it's the airship that one of the 12 gods,\nStormia the Goddess of Wind, can fly.
A god's airship?! So if we use that...
Yeah, we can go anywhere, even to the world\noutside our world. However...
However what?
Stormia has been away for so long that\nwe no longer know where the ark is...
Whaat, that's no good then...
But even if we don't know where it is, according\nto my father, Obligaus, the ship won't disappear\nif the god who made it hasn't dismantled it.
You're saying that it's somewhere in this world,\nright? But there's no way we can find it if we\ndon't even know where it is.
The thing is the Wind Ark is the only means to get\nyou to Toram. And it's not that I have no clue\nat all about its whereabouts.
Why don't you try going to Lunagent Mountain\nfirst? It's the place where the Wind Ark was last\nseen flying...
L-L-L-L-Lunagent Mountain?!
Yeah, a citizen of Calle Mort saw it...\nFirst, I think you should try to talk to that\nperson.
It's only natural that Pelulu is shivering\nviolently...She tries her best to bury the memory\nof the monster encountered in Lunagent Mountain...
Perhaps King Elbano had predicted that we might go\nto the dangerous Lunagent Mountain,
that's why he suggested that Reliza and the\nElf Warriors come with us...
Wait! Have you forgot about the terrifying monster\nthat attacked us?!
You explained that the monster had been defeated\nwith Grecia's arrow and if it's a Coenubia,\nit might have left some clues...
Hmph...But if such creature is still there...
But Lunagent Mountain seems to be the only clue\nwe have for now. I think we should go.\nWe'll help when danger rears its ugly head...
Alright then!\nBut if you die this time, I'mma abandon you and\nrun off!
Oh?! Pino!\nWhy are you here?
Thank you for your hard work everyone. I came\nbecause I heard the Wind Ark had been found...\nSo, where is it?
You told her that the sunken ark had been raised\nand there wasn't much damage. You also told her\nthat Navie, Stormia's deputy, is watching it
while sleeping. You told her that you were unable\nto continue the journey as nobody knew how to\nnavigate the ship...
I see...So you just hit a snag at a critical\njuncture...
If that's the case, I can navigate it!
Whaaat?!
R-really?!
Yeah...When I was very young, I got Stormia to\nteach me the basics of marine navigation.\nIt was really just the basics tho...
Oh yaaaas!\nThat means we can go to Toram!!
Yippee-yay! We can go to Toram ♪
However...\nI can't go to where the ark is now...
Whoaaat?!
Yeah...I got a report from Saria who went to get\nthe residents of Nov Diela, the Diel's city-state\nsituated past Rokoko Plains.
She said that Nov Diela is being surrounded by\nsomething and Rolca who entered the city area\nfirst got trapped in the city with the residents.
Oh no, what a bad timing...
Aye...really dab timing~
Hey, I bet you don't even understand what you just\nsaid...
It's my duty as a president to save my\nsubordinates and people that are in danger...\nI must go to Nov Diela!
What?! You?! But, you alone won't be enough to...
Nope, this person is not alone! I'm going too!!
Aye! Me too!!
But, aren't you a merchant...?\nAnd you are...?
Eh? Oh, uh, well, yeah, right!\nBut don't sweat the small stuff!!
Aye, don't sweat it, don't sweat it!
It's not going to be just the adventurers.\nKing Elbano commanded that we back them up!!
Since you're a president and the Goddess of\nJustice, just take it easy. No need to worry too\nmuch!
...Fine. I'll put my subordinates and people's\nlives in your hands! You must bring them back\nalive!!
Excuse me! Could you please wait for a while?
Sorry, I know you all are in a hurry.\nBut on your way to Nov Diela,
Could you please stop by the stone monument in\nRonfa Mountain Ruins situated past the city ruins\nbeyond Rokoko Plains?
Sofys! What are you talking about?!\nThe lives of the people in Nov Diela are at stake,\nyou know?! It's a race against the clock...
I do understand that too.\nCalm down, Obligaus.
Stopping by the stone monument in Ronfa will\ndefinitely help to save the people of Nov Diela...
Once you find the stone monument,\nI would like you to offer this...
Pino handed a flower made out of paper to you...
A paper flower...??\nThat will help save the people of Nov Diela??\nSofys, what's actually the meaning of this...
Please do as I say.
A-a-a stone monument in Ronfaaa?
Rolca, Saria, thank you.\nI'm glad that you managed to protect the people of\nNov Diela...
What a great, happy ending!\nThat means now you can navigate the ark, right?
Finally, the ark will be navigated~!\nYay~!!
Er...about that actually...
On second thought, I realized that the\nNew Mithurna was just formed recently,
Therefore, as the president and Goddess of Justice\nworshiped by the Diels, I shouldn't be away from\nthe country for too long...
W-w-w-wait a sec, are you telling us that you've\njust realized that you're a president and a\ngoddess now?! I'm speechless!!
If you can't go, who will navigate the ark and\ntake us to another world then?!
Yeah, that's right! Who will navigate the ark\nthen?!
In that case, shall I undertake that task?
Ohh, it's Oritius!\nDid you just come back from Dunkelis'?
Yeah...Anyway, as I used to operate a battleship\nwhich is technically similar to this ark, I think\nI can navigate it. I'll do it in place of Kunon...
Hold on! You can't go!
D-daddy?! What...even mommy's here!!
Hey, I know you're surprised, but still, you\nshould use Father and Mother when you're calling\nus.
Long time no see, Obligaus!\nWhy can't I go?
I'm no longer a god, however...I can still tell\nthat this world seems to become unstable due to\nthe loss of gods' power...
You and Dunkelis talked about it, didn't you?\nThat she and a special god like you would do\nsomething until the gods' power returns.
And that means you need to stay in this world.\nAm I wrong?
...Right. I got carried away by my desire to help\nthem and fight the enemies that are threats to\nthe world that I almost forgot about that...
Hey, by the way, don't you think Kunon's mother is\nsomehow glowing? She's like so transparent...\nOh no?! Could she be a ghost?! Oh my gosh...
B-but, if you look closely,\nshe's not really scary.\nBesides...she's very beautiful...
But if...If I go now, that means there will be no\nGoddess of Justice here and I'm afraid that\nthe hall of the shrine will crumble...
Fortunately, I haven't transferred all my power to\nyou...
Alright! For the time being, Curonne and I will\ntake care of this country!! I guess I can somehow\nsustain the hall too with my remaining power!
Kunon, I bet you have seen many things in this\nworld while migrating the people to build\nMithurna...
So this time I would like you to go see the world\nthat even Obligaus and I have never seen before\nwith that adventurer.
I'm sure it will help broaden your perception as\nthe new Goddess of Justice...
Dad, Mom!\nI got it, I'll go then!!
Hey, you're the new Goddess of Justice, you should\nwatch the way you talk...
Make sure you become a better and more mature\ngoddess when you come back!\nHahaha!!
I like what I'm seeing...
Yeah, it's so emotional...
Please look out for Kunon...
You pass the folded paper from the ghost at the\nstone monument to Pino...You pretend that you\npicked it up since the encounter was a secret...
? What's this paper? It was on the ground near\nthe grave? I believe no one goes near that place\nthough. I see strange things do happen...
...I'm asking just in case though...\nThis isn't a prank, is it...? Oh, it can't be...\nThis is definitely his handwriting...
As a god's child, I was serving as the chief\nconsul when Sofya was the country's capital.\nThat stone monument is the tomb of the...
Armaments Caravan's leader who protected me from\nconspiracies and devotedly supported me as I was\nstruggling to cope with pressure...
Human lifespan is very different from that of\ngods...He became old and he was gone from my sight\nway before I grew into a fine Goddess of Wisdom.
However, even after that, he remained in this\nworld and he might have been watching over me...
"Even if I'm not around, I promise that I'll\nalways support you"...That's also what he had told\nme countless times...
Thank you. Besides going to his grave to offer the\nflower for me, you've also helped him deliver his\nmessage to me...
This is only a small token of my gratitude.\nPlease accept it...
Hey, secretly receiving something from Pino?!\nThat's not fair!\nShare it with me later!
It seems that Kunon is ready too, let's go to\nnavigate the ark!!
